scope: Separate opt-in publisher reconstruction; unchanged physical profiles and frozen numerical recipe. Development and fresh evidence must remain distinct.

fresh.scope: Three predeclared original calendars after frozen forecasts; same ARC publisher, clock comparison not observed physical/event-date accuracy

forecastFreeze.scope: Three new place/year original calendars, queried coordinates equal calculation inputs; not official named reference points, a new institution or observational truth.
forecastFreeze.decision: Old USNO compatibility retained. Midpoint-rounding and NOAA/Meeus counterprobes rejected on exposed data before these forecasts. No changes selected from these new references.
forecastFreeze.comparison: Six event clocks; direct difference except midnight circular only. Count unavailable pairs separately. Retain every DST anomaly in primary metrics; source lacks event-specific UTC instants.

exportParity.scope: All eight exposed annuals; exact model/location and six event raw/rounded/date/status fields match frozen private candidate. Public wrapper adds explicit quality and unspecified Asr/Isha.

independentReview.scope: Additive interface, copied-math preservation and model timestamp semantics; no publisher accuracy or religious correctness claim
